invariants: One retained enabled physics group, not a hidden loop over dropped groups. groupIndex is inline_physics_group.group_index (original payload index), never0 by assumption.

One retained IK controller. controllerIndex is inline_ik_controller.controller_index (original payload index). Pole presence_flags bit0/bit1 are distinct from zero field words; finalized target bindings explicitly set the relevant presence bit.

Physics stage_slot is separate from destination_slot: node owner destinationSlot for bone commit is the bone_staged_destinations index, while .owner_slot identifies BoneSlot. The parameter and bone stage-slot spaces are distinct first-appearance domains.
Bone override presence_mask bits0..4 select x,y,angle,scale_x,scale_y respectively; a zero value with a set bit overrides the immutable default.
Skin ranges come from the mesh-evaluator selected SkinSlot; inverse entries are matched by BoneSlot only inside that skin range. Original weightIndex is not renumbered when an inverse is absent.
world_pass is0 before solver when controller exists,1 at final world; boneDfsIndex counts world-order traversal, not storage BoneSlot.

physics.output.destinationSlot is owner storage; physics.output.stageSlot selects staging. Parameter commit copies stage[destinationSlot] to parameter_update[parameter_staged_destinations[destinationSlot].owner_slot]; bone-commit owner destinationSlot remains the stage index while its write targets bone_staged_destinations[destinationSlot].owner_slot.
